lines.en: label rindorm40:
I knock on the door and wait for Rin to respond.
lines.zh: 我敲了敲门，等着 Rin 回应。

lines.en: It isn’t until I bring my ear closer to the door, however, that I notice it’s a bit...louder than normal in there.
lines.zh: 直到我把耳朵贴近门，才注意到里面比平时要……吵一点。

lines.en: I wonder if something is going on?
lines.zh: 难道里面在搞什么名堂？

lines.en: : One...sec!
lines.zh: : 等……一下！

lines.en: : Futaba...watch your hands!
lines.zh: : Futaba……管好你的手！

lines.en: : But this is...the best way to do it...
lines.zh: : 可这是……最好的办法了……

lines.en: : But it’s...mine...I think I know...the best way!
lines.zh: : 但那是……我的……我觉得我知道……最好的办法！

lines.en: : You can not make noises like that and expect me to not immediately come in.
lines.zh: : 你们发出那种声音，就别指望我不会立刻冲进来了。

lines.en: : Just...hold on!
lines.zh: : 就……等一下！

lines.en: : So close to being...finished!
lines.zh: : 马上就……弄好了！

lines.en: : What are you two doing in there?
lines.zh: : 你们俩在里面干什么呢？

lines.en: : Rin...were you...expecting Sensei?...
lines.zh: : Rin……你是在……等 Sensei 吗？……

lines.en: : No, but...he can obviously join in...
lines.zh: : 不是，不过……他显然可以一起来的……

lines.en: : He’ll be a...huge help...don’t you think?
lines.zh: : 他会……帮上大忙的……你觉得呢？

lines.en: : Yes. I will help with anything. Just name it.
lines.zh: : 好。什么忙我都帮。尽管开口。

lines.en: : Will he?...We’re basically done already...
lines.zh: : 真的吗？……我们都已经快弄完了……

lines.en: : Yeah...just...
: ...Ahhhh!
: There...
lines.zh: : 好了……

lines.en: : Coming, Sensei!
lines.zh: : 来了，Sensei！

lines.en: scene black
Rin runs to the door and unlocks it, pulling it open and flagging me in.
lines.zh: Rin 跑到门口把锁打开，拉开门招手让我进去。

lines.en: I’m not exactly sure what sort of “activity” they need my help with but, as their teacher, it is my duty to-
lines.zh: 我不太确定她们要我帮的是什么「忙」，但作为她们的老师，我有责任——

lines.en: scene rinfutabanewdorm1
: Ta-da!
lines.zh: : 当当！

lines.en: : Umm...hey...
: Sorry for the hold-up, Sensei. Futaba was helping me move my new bed into the corner.
lines.zh: : 让你久等了，Sensei。Futaba 在帮我把新床挪到角落里。

lines.en: : You should be more specific when you’re letting out pained, exasperated yelps from behind a locked door.
lines.zh: : 你们在锁着的门后面发出那种痛苦又气喘的叫声，最好说清楚一点。

lines.en: : Or maybe {i}you{/i} should stop eavesdropping on people.
lines.zh: : 或者{i}你{/i}干脆别偷听别人。

lines.en: : I think it stopped being eavesdropping the moment I knocked.
lines.zh: : 我觉得从我敲门的那一刻起，就不算偷听了。

lines.en: : What exactly...did you think we were doing?
lines.zh: : 你……到底以为我们在干什么？

lines.en: : Probably having sex.
lines.zh: : 大概是在做爱吧。

lines.en: scene rinfutabanewdorm2
: With...each other?!
: I know how it sounds but I’m really not the only one at fault here.
lines.zh: : 我知道这话听着很怪，但这事真不能只怪我一个人。

lines.en: : Liking the new set-up, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 喜欢这个新格局吗，Sensei？

lines.en: : We spent pretty much the whole evening putting everything together.
lines.zh: : 我们差不多花了一整个晚上才把所有东西拼好。

lines.en: : It only took one evening? Even the floor is different.
lines.zh: : 一晚上就搞定了？连地板都换过了。

lines.en: : I feel like this should have taken a lot longer.
lines.zh: : 我觉得这怎么也得花上更久吧。

lines.en: : Yeah, I don’t know.
lines.zh: : 嗯，我也不知道。

lines.en: : I guess the maintenance crew handled swapping out the flooring while we were at[school] or something.
lines.zh: : 大概是我们去 [school] 的时候，维修工人顺手把地板给换了吧。

lines.en: : I’m not arguing. I love the new look.
lines.zh: : 我可没意见。我很喜欢这个新样子。

lines.en: scene rinfutabanewdorm3
: It’s a little more...colorful than I was expecting. But it {i}is{/i} a nice change of pace.
lines.zh: : 比我预想的要……花哨一点。不过换个感觉也不错。

lines.en: : Why the need for the sudden renovation? Your room seemed fine.
lines.zh: : 怎么突然要翻新？你房间之前看着挺好的啊。

lines.en: : It {i}was{/i} fine, just a little out of date.
lines.zh: : {i}是{/i}挺好的，就是有点过时了。

lines.en: : All of the other rooms were actually renovated before ours.
lines.zh: : 其实其他房间都在我们之前就翻新过了。

lines.en: : But right when it was our turn, they had to call everything off for financial reasons or something.
lines.zh: : 可轮到我们的时候，他们因为资金之类的原因把工程全叫停了。

lines.en: : Either way, we’re caught up now.
lines.zh: : 总之，我们现在总算赶上了。

lines.en: : And, look! I even got to keep my best friends!
lines.zh: : 而且，你看！我连最好的朋友们都保住了！

lines.en: : Your...what?
lines.zh: : 你的……什么？

lines.en: scene rinfutabanewdorm4
Rin hops onto her bed and quickly points to her shelf full of human skulls that somehow managed to survive the dorm renovation.
lines.zh: Rin 跳上床，迅速指向她那排骷髅头——不知道怎么的，它们居然在宿舍翻新中活了下来。

lines.en: : These little dudes right here.
lines.zh: : 就是这几个小家伙。

lines.en: : I was finally starting to forget you even had those.
lines.zh: : 我都快忘了你还有这些玩意儿了。

lines.en: : You really think I could survive without these? Come on, man. You know me better than that.
lines.zh: : 你真觉得没有它们我活得下去？拜托，老兄。你该更了解我才对。

lines.en: : Do I really, though?
lines.zh: : 真的吗，我了解吗？

lines.en: : Hey, Sensei, want to hold one?
lines.zh: : 嘿，Sensei，想拿一个吗？

lines.en: : Not really?
lines.zh: : 还是不要了吧？

lines.en: : What if I tell you one belonged to a [teenage]girl? That’ll get you going, right?
lines.zh: : 那如果我告诉你其中一个属于一个 [teenage]女孩呢？这样你就来劲了吧？

lines.en: : My appreciation for [teenage]girls doesn’t really persist through death, believe it or not.
lines.zh: : 信不信由你，我对 [teenage]女孩的欣赏不会延续到她们死后。

lines.en: scene rinfutabanewdorm5
: Well then you’re missing out.
lines.zh: : 那你就亏大了。

lines.en: : Death is when the {i}real{/i} fun starts...
lines.zh: : 死了以后才是{i}真正{/i}的好玩……

lines.en: scene rinfutabanewdorm6
: Is she okay?
lines.zh: : 她没事吧？

lines.en: : I...ask myself that all the time.
lines.zh: : 我……也一直在问自己这个问题。

lines.en: : She’s just...really attached to those skulls for some reason.
lines.zh: : 她只是……不知道为什么特别依恋这些骷髅。

lines.en: : Hey, I don’t judge you for being attached to your books.
lines.zh: : 嘿，我可没笑话你依恋你的书。

lines.en: scene rinfutabanewdorm7
: I don’t {i}kiss{/i} my books, though...
lines.zh: : 但我不会{i}亲{/i}我的书啊……

lines.en: : She {i}kisses{/i} them?
lines.zh: : 她{i}亲{/i}它们？

lines.en: scene rinfutabanewdorm8
: Just the one time...
lines.zh: : 就那一次……

lines.en: : I hope.
lines.zh: : 希望是吧。

lines.en: : Rin, do you-
lines.zh: : Rin，你有没有——

lines.en: : No comment.
lines.zh: : 无可奉告。

lines.en: : That can’t be sanitary.
lines.zh: : 这也太不卫生了吧。

lines.en: : More sanitary than Molly, probably. I’m still kind of reeling from that thing at the Christmas party.
lines.zh: : 大概总比 Molly 卫生。我到现在还没从圣诞派对那件事里缓过来。

lines.en: : Like, for real. What made her think that was a cool thing to do?
lines.zh: : 真的，说真的。她到底哪来的自信觉得那么做很酷？

lines.en: if mollydorm20 == True:
I’m pretty sure I know {i}exactly{/i} why she did it...
lines.zh: 我大概{i}很清楚{/i}她为什么那么做……

lines.en: scene rinfutabanewdorm9
: Just because you don’t like her that way doesn’t make her unsanitary...
lines.zh: : 只是因为你对她没那个意思，不代表她不讲卫生……

lines.en: : She’s just as sanitary as you and me. We literally shower together.
lines.zh: : 她跟你我一样干净。我们可是一起洗澡的。

lines.en: : Yes. Talk more about this.
lines.zh: : 嗯。多说说。

lines.en: : Describe these showers in vivid detail.
lines.zh: : 把洗澡的细节生动地描述一下。

lines.en: : Futaba, put those things away. They’re getting our teacher riled up.
lines.zh: : Futaba，把这些东西收起来。别把老师给挑逗起来了。

lines.en: : Where would I even hide them?
lines.zh: : 我还能藏到哪儿去？

lines.en: {i}In my hands.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}在我手里。{/i}

lines.en: scene rinfutabanewdorm10
: Molly aside, welcome to the brand new Dorm #4, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 先不说 Molly 了，欢迎来到全新的四号宿舍，Sensei。

lines.en: : I’m sure you’ll be spending a lot of time in here from now on, so get used to it.
lines.zh: : 我敢说你以后会在这儿待很久，趁早习惯吧。

lines.en: : Well, at least until the[school] year ends and we’re forced to change rooms.
lines.zh: : 至少在 [school] 学年结束、我们被迫换房间之前是这样。

lines.en: : You can’t put in a good word for us to make sure we get this one again, can you?
lines.zh: : 你就不能帮我们说说话，好让我们下次还分到这间吗？

lines.en: : I’ve only lived here for half an hour but I’m already pretty attached.
lines.zh: : 我在这儿才住了半个钟头，就已经挺舍不得了。

lines.en: : We’ve lived here for a lot longer than half an hour...
lines.zh: : 我们在这儿住的时间可比半个钟头长多了……

lines.en: : The only thing different is the floor and some of the furniture.
lines.zh: : 不一样的只有地板和几件家具而已。

lines.en: scene rinfutabanewdorm11
: Speaking of brand new furniture, what do you think we should do with our table?
lines.zh: : 说到新家具，你觉得我们这张桌子该怎么处理？

lines.en: : Can...tables do more than just be...tables?
lines.zh: : 桌子……除了当……桌子还能干嘛？

lines.en: : A table can do anything it puts its mind to, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 只要桌子下定决心，它什么都能做到，Sensei。

lines.en: : ...What?
: I think I’m fine with it just holding a vase for now...
lines.zh: : 我觉得现在就让它放个花瓶挺好的……

lines.en: : Okay, but the second we need it for anything other than that, you can bet your big ole’ boobies that I’m dropkicking that vase all the way to North Dakota.
lines.zh: : 行，但等哪天我们需要它干点别的，我敢拿你那对大宝贝打赌，我会把这个花瓶一路飞踢到北达科他州去。

lines.en: : Do you even know where North Dakota is, Rin?
lines.zh: : 你知道北达科他在哪儿吗，Rin？

lines.en: scene rinfutabanewdorm12
: Right above the south one, idiot.
lines.zh: : 在南边那个的上面啊，笨蛋。

lines.en: : Rin drank four energy drinks while we were moving things around, so please forgive her for her...hyperness today.
lines.zh: : 搬东西的时候 Rin 灌了四罐功能饮料，所以请原谅她今天……亢奋成这样。

lines.en: : I thought all of the coffee I drink at work would have made me immune to caffeine but apparently I can still get some effects if I just overload on it.
lines.zh: : 我本来以为上班喝那么多咖啡，早该对咖啡因免疫了，看来只要剂量够大，我还是会有反应。

lines.en: : Uh-huh...
lines.zh: : 嗯哼……

lines.en: : Tell him the other reason you’re acting hyper as well.
lines.zh: : 把你亢奋的另一个原因也告诉他。

lines.en: : Other reason?
lines.zh: : 另一个原因？

lines.en: scene rinfutabanewdorm13
: Otoha and me are gonna go on a date soon!
lines.zh: : 我和 Otoha 很快要去约会啦！

lines.en: : Well, she didn’t call it a date. And neither did I.
lines.zh: : 嗯，她没说是约会。我也没说。

lines.en: : That is...exactly what you just called it.
lines.zh: : 你刚才……就是这么叫的。

lines.en: : Semantics.
lines.zh: : 咬文嚼字。

lines.en: : Well, congratulations either way. It’s clear that this is the best thing that’s happened to you in quite some time.
lines.zh: : 反正先恭喜你。看得出来，这是你这么久以来最开心的一件事。

lines.en: : Probably ever.
lines.zh: : 大概是有史以来最开心的。

lines.en: : That would just be depressing.
lines.zh: : 那可就太丧了。

lines.en: : Have you two decided what you’re going to do yet?
lines.zh: : 你们俩决定好要做什么了吗？

lines.en: scene rinfutabanewdorm14
: We’re gonna go check out some arcade near her house that I looked up online.
lines.zh: : 我们打算去她家附近的一家游戏厅，我在网上查到的。

lines.en: : It’s supposed to be this cool kind of arcade thingy where they have shows and sell alcohol and stuff.
lines.zh: : 据说那是个很酷的游戏厅，里面有表演，还卖酒什么的。

lines.en: : And sure, neither of us are old enough to drink, but they’ll still let us in. I checked that part out online, too.
lines.zh: : 当然，我们都还没到能喝酒的年纪，但他们还是会让我们进去的。这点我也上网查过了。

lines.en: : You put a lot of thought into this, haven’t you?
lines.zh: : 你在这上面花了不少心思啊。

lines.en: scene rinfutabanewdorm15
: Despite never having a relationship with anyone and never even holding hands-
lines.zh: : 虽然我从没跟任何人谈过恋爱，连手都没牵过——

lines.en: : You had your first kiss before ever holding hands?
lines.zh: : 你还没牵过手就先接吻了？

lines.en: : Please don’t remind me.
lines.zh: : 别提了行吗。

lines.en: : But, as I was saying, despite all of that, Rin Rokuhara is a dating expert.
lines.zh: : 不过，就像我刚才说的，尽管这样，Rin Rokuhara 可是约会专家。

lines.en: : I know all the spots, all the right things to say, and possess none of the courage required to actually capitalize on either of those things.
lines.zh: : 所有好玩的地方我都知道，所有该说的话我都会说，唯独缺的是把这两样真正用出来的勇气。

lines.en: : She also wrote fan fiction for an anime series she likes and counts that as proper dating experience.
lines.zh: : 她还会给自己喜欢的动画写同人文，并且把那也算作正经的恋爱经验。

lines.en: : That part could have been left out, but yes. Thank you, Futaba, for sharing one of my darkest secrets with Sensei.
lines.zh: : 这段其实可以不说的，不过行吧。谢谢你啊，Futaba，把我最见不得人的秘密之一分享给 Sensei。

lines.en: : You’re lucky that I haven’t yet told him you wanted to marry your dad when you were little.
lines.zh: : 你该庆幸我还没告诉他，你小时候说过想嫁给你爸爸。

lines.en: scene rinfutabanewdorm16
: Th-That’s a totally normal thing that a lot of little girls say!
lines.zh: : 那、那可是很多小女孩都会说的很正常的话！

lines.en: : Not me! I wanted to marry my {i}mom{/i}.
lines.zh: : 我可没说过！我想嫁的是我{i}妈妈{/i}。

lines.en: : How is that any better?!
lines.zh: : 这有什么更好的？！

lines.en: : It’s more progressive. I’m clearly a better person than you.
lines.zh: : 更进步啊。我显然比你是个更好的人。

lines.en: : Wait, just to clarify, Futaba {i}does{/i} know about your other “secret” right?
lines.zh: : 等等，确认一下，Futaba 知道你另一个「秘密」吧？

lines.en: scene rinfutabanewdorm17
: Oh, totally. It didn’t come out until the whole thing with Chika boiled over but she’s apparently known for a really long time.
lines.zh: : 当然知道。Chika 那件事闹开之前都没人知道，但她好像早就知道了。

lines.en: : So I just stopped trying to hide it and now I have somebody to talk about girls with all day long.
lines.zh: : 所以我也就不藏着了，现在整天都有人陪我聊女孩子。

lines.en: : I’ll admit that it’s a little awkward since...{i}I’m{/i} not into girls, but...if Rin wants to vent, I’ll be here to listen.
lines.zh: : 我承认是有点尴尬，毕竟……{i}我{/i}对女生没兴趣，但……如果 Rin 想倾诉，我会听着的。

lines.en: : Same. Especially if you want to go into vivid detail about anything that happens with them.
lines.zh: : 我也一样。尤其是如果你想把跟她们之间发生的事讲得很详细的话。

lines.en: scene rinfutabanewdorm18
: Boy, will I ever.
lines.zh: : 那我可太会了。

lines.en: : You two are...kind of scary when you look at each other like that.
lines.zh: : 你们俩……那样看着对方的时候有点吓人。

lines.en: : Don’t look down on us just because you’re too prude to talk about cool sex stuff.
lines.zh: : 别因为你太古板、聊不了这些性感话题就看不起我们。

lines.en: : I bet you don’t even know how to do the sex, Futaba.
lines.zh: : 我打赌你根本不会「做那个」，Futaba。

lines.en: : That was a slightly compelling argument until you made it to that “do the sex” part.
lines.zh: : 本来还挺有说服力的，直到你说出「做那个」那部分。

lines.en: : That’s what we’re calling it nowadays. Ask anyone.
lines.zh: : 现在大家都这么叫。随便问谁都行。

lines.en: scene rinfutabanewdorm19
: We’re really not...
lines.zh: : 我们真的不这么叫……

lines.en: : It’s just Rin.
lines.zh: : 就 Rin 这么叫。

lines.en: : It’ll catch on. Watch.
lines.zh: : 会流行起来的。走着瞧。

lines.en: : So the gameplan is basically...meet up, cool arcade date, and then “doing the sex” with Otoha?
lines.zh: : 所以计划基本就是……碰面，去很酷的游戏厅约会，然后跟 Otoha「做那个」？

lines.en: scene rinfutabanewdorm20
: Wait wait wait wait wait! I still haven’t even confirmed that she likes girls yet!
lines.zh: : 等等等等等等！我连她是不是喜欢女生都还没确认呢！

lines.en: : But you told me in the past that all girls kind of like girls.
lines.zh: : 可你以前跟我说过，所有女生都有点喜欢女生。

lines.en: : They do!
lines.zh: : 就是啊！

lines.en: : That is...not true...
lines.zh: : 这……不对吧……

lines.en: scene rinfutabanewdorm21
: Shut up and be supportive, so-called “best friend!”
lines.zh: : 闭嘴，支持我一下，所谓的「最好的朋友」！

lines.en: : S...Sorry...
lines.zh: : 对……对不起……

lines.en: scene rinfutabanewdorm20
: But...yeah! There are a bunch of steps between going to an arcade and tying the lesbian tongue-knot.
lines.zh: : 不过……是啊！从去游戏厅到系上女同性恋的舌头结，中间还有很多步骤呢。

lines.en: : And one of those steps is confirming that the girl you’re trying to tie that knot with is actually into the same stuff that you are.
lines.zh: : 其中一步就是，先确认你想跟她系那个结的女生，是不是也喜欢同一套东西。

lines.en: I hope she doesn’t mean skulls.
lines.zh: 希望她说的不是骷髅。

lines.en: : You do know that “tying the knot” means getting married, right?
lines.zh: : 你知道「系结」是结婚的意思吧？

lines.en: : Obviously! That’s why I said “lesbian tongue knot!”
lines.zh: : 当然知道！所以我才说「女同性恋的舌头结」啊！

lines.en: : That does sound a lot more interesting, I won’t lie.
lines.zh: : 听着确实有意思多了，我不骗你。

lines.en: scene rinfutabanewdorm22
: I’m super nervous, though, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 不过我超级紧张，Sensei。

lines.en: if rinbetrayed == False:
: Like, what if it’s a repeat of the whole Chika situation and Otoha figures out that I think she’s cute and then never wants to see me again?
lines.zh: : 就怕又变成 Chika 那回事，Otoha 发现我觉得她很可爱，然后就再也不想见我了。

lines.en: : I mean...you haven’t known Otoha for nearly as long.
lines.zh: : 怎么说呢……你认识 Otoha 的时间也没那么长。

lines.en: : So if something like that {i}does{/i} happen, do you really think it will hit you as hard?
lines.zh: : 所以就算{i}真{/i}发生那样的事，你觉得对你的打击会有那么大吗？

lines.en: : Probably not, but that doesn’t mean I’m not still scared.
lines.zh: : 大概不会，但这不代表我不害怕。

lines.en: : Just don’t go confessing your love out of virtually nowhere and everything will be okay.
lines.zh: : 只要你别再莫名其妙地突然告白，一切都会没事的。

lines.en: : It’s not love, obviously. But she’s so cool and I want her to like me and I can be kind of hard to like when I get all...Rin-ish.
lines.zh: : 那当然不是爱啦。但她太酷了，我想让她喜欢我，而我一旦变得很……Rin 起来，就挺难让人喜欢的。

lines.en: else:
: Like, what if it’s a repeat of the whole Chika situation?
lines.zh: : 就怕又变成 Chika 那回事。

lines.en: scene rinfutabanewdorm23
: I swear, if I find out you’ve been fucking around with {i}Otoha{/i} despite barely even knowing her, I will literally never talk to you again.
lines.zh: : 我发誓，要是我发现你才刚认识 {i}Otoha{/i} 没多久就乱来，我是真的再也不会理你了。

lines.en: : I can assure you that has not happened.
lines.zh: : 我可以向你保证，没有那种事。

lines.en: Though, I can’t say I’d be entirely opposed if the opportunity arose...
lines.zh: 不过，要真有机会送上门，我也不能说自己会完全拒绝……

lines.en: : Wait...what happened?
lines.zh: : 等等……怎么了？

lines.en: : Nothing, Futaba. I’m just worried, that’s all.
lines.zh: : 没什么，Futaba。我只是有点担心，就这样。

lines.en: : Things like this have a history of going kind of bad for me.
lines.zh: : 这种事在我身上总是容易搞砸。

lines.en: : And how long is that history, exactly? Just one time, right?
lines.zh: : 这个「总是」到底有多长？就一次而已吧？

lines.en: : Yes it’s one time but that’s also a 100%% failure rate.
lines.zh: : 是只有一次，可那也是 100%% 的失败率啊。

lines.en: : Otoha’s so cool and...pretty and...I just want her to like me.
lines.zh: : Otoha 又酷又……漂亮，而且……我就是想让她喜欢我。

lines.en: : But it’s probably really hard to like someone when they act all...Rin-ish.
lines.zh: : 可要是我整个人变得很……Rin 起来，别人大概真的很难喜欢我。

lines.en: scene rinfutabanewdorm24
: I...obviously can’t speak for Sensei, but...
lines.zh: : 我……显然没法替 Sensei 说话，不过……

lines.en: : I think how flustered you get is one of your cutest qualities...
lines.zh: : 我觉得你手足无措的样子是你最可爱的地方之一……

lines.en: : And if there’s anyone who doesn’t appreciate that part of you, I don’t think I’d...sign off on them dating you.
lines.zh: : 如果有人不懂得欣赏你这一面，我想我大概不会……同意他跟你交往。

lines.en: : Are you sure you don’t like girls, Futaba? Cause I kinda wanna kiss you after hearing that.
lines.zh: : 你确定你不喜欢女生吗，Futaba？听完这话我都有点想亲你了。

lines.en: : You can kiss me if you want.
lines.zh: : 你想亲的话可以亲。

lines.en: if rinbetrayed == True:
: No thanks.
lines.zh: : 不用了。

lines.en: : Wow, not even a thought.
lines.zh: : 哇，想都不想一下。

lines.en: else:
: No way. Futaba’s in the room. It would be weird with her watching.
lines.zh: : 不行。Futaba 在屋里呢。被她看着会很奇怪。

lines.en: : ...Wait, so it would be okay if she wasn’t in the room?
lines.zh: : ……等等，所以她不在屋里就可以了？

lines.en: : Nobody is kissing anyone...
lines.zh: : 谁也不许亲谁……

lines.en: : If you’re nervous about your date that...may or may not even be a date, you can talk to me about it.
lines.zh: : 如果你对这场……可能算也可能不算约会的约会感到紧张，可以来跟我聊聊。

lines.en: : And if you have any questions about how to impress girls, I’d be willing to lend a hand as well.
lines.zh: : 要是你想知道怎么讨女孩子欢心，我也愿意帮把手。

lines.en: scene rinfutabanewdorm25
: What? Since when do you know how to impress girls, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 什么？Sensei 什么时候学会讨女孩子欢心了？

lines.en: : His...writing skills are impressive at least...
lines.zh: : 他的……写作水平倒是挺厉害的……

lines.en: : Does Otoha like...writing?
lines.zh: : Otoha 喜欢……写作吗？

lines.en: : There are other impressive things about me.
lines.zh: : 我身上厉害的地方不止这一处。

lines.en: : Just...one of them isn’t legal to break out unless the circumstances are right.
lines.zh: : 只是……其中一样除非时机对，拿出来是违法的。

lines.en: : Circumstances? But what-
lines.zh: : 时机？可是什么——

lines.en: scene rinfutabanewdorm26
: Ewwww...
: What a weird time to brag...
lines.zh: : 这时候吹牛也太怪了吧……

lines.en: : Yeah...maybe it’s best if you...leave that part to me as well, Sensei...
lines.zh: : 嗯……Sensei，这部分你最好也……交给我来吧……

lines.en: scene black
I spend a little while longer hanging out with Rin and Futaba before the two of them decide it’s time to kick me out so they can lie down.
lines.zh: 我又陪 Rin 和 Futaba 待了一会儿，之后她们俩决定把我赶出去，好躺下休息。

lines.en: It only makes sense given how exhausted they must be from reorganizing things, but I also thought Rin’s energy drink high would have lasted a bit longer.
lines.zh: 考虑到她们整理东西肯定累坏了，这也说得通，不过我原以为 Rin 的功能饮料劲头能撑得久一点。

lines.en: Either way, it’s clear that the conversation was going to continue to head into territory I probably wouldn’t be of any help for.
lines.zh: 不管怎样，很明显接下来的话题会往我大概帮不上忙的方向发展。

lines.en: And sure, it’s disheartening that, once again, Rin is starting to fall for someone with a vagina-
lines.zh: 当然，Rin 又一次开始喜欢上一个有阴道的人，这确实让人有点泄气——

lines.en: But it’s not like I expect her to just change her primary preference overnight.
lines.zh: 但我也不指望她一夜之间就能改掉自己的主要偏好。

lines.en: No one can help who they fall for.
lines.zh: 人没法控制自己会喜欢上谁。

lines.en: I just wish she didn’t fall so hard, so easily.
lines.zh: 我只是希望她别每次都陷得那么深、那么快。

lines.en: $ rindorm40 = True
$ rin_love += 1
{i}Rin’s affection has increased to [rin_love]!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}Rin 的好感度提升到了 [rin_love]!{/i}
